name: studens
description: Modular web platform for students in higher education

scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run schema:validate
scripts.dev: npm run build:api && (STUDENS_DEV_IDENTITY=1 node apps/api/dist/index.js & npm run --workspace @studens/web dev)
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:api && STUDENS_DEV_IDENTITY=1 node apps/api/dist/index.js
scripts.db:grant-local: psql -d "${PGDATABASE:-studens}" -q -c "GRANT studens_platform, studens_ref, studens_ryc TO CURRENT_USER"
scripts.gates:db: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:grant-local && npm run db:verify-isolation && npm run test:db
